goal: Create a hosted checkout page for a monthly subscription to a given price for an existing customer, allowing promo codes, and return the URL to redirect to.

Write a function that takes a raw request body and signature header, verifies the event is genuine, and handles three cases: a completed checkout, an updated subscription (read its status and when the current billing period ends), and a failed invoice payment (read the customer and amount due).
Find a customer by email or create one if none exists, attaching an internal user id as metadata, and return the customer id.
Start a one-time card payment of $19.99 USD that lets the dashboard decide which payment methods to offer, and return what the browser needs to confirm it.
Set a subscription to cancel at the end of the current period, then return the date access ends and the id of the price the customer is on.
Collect the ids and totals of every paid invoice for a customer, however many pages there are.
Create a self-service billing portal link for a customer, and separately refund a payment in full, returning a friendly message if the card network declines or the API reports an error.
Report 250 units of metered usage for a customer against a usage meter named api_requests, then create a subscription for that customer on a metered price.
